facts.fact: Sudan's Ministries of Health and Digital Transformation and Communications launched phase one of a hospital management system programme at Al-Nao Hospital in Khartoum State and the diagnostic centre of Gedaref Hospital, a system the report says comprises integrated applications for civil registration and vital statistics, electronic patient record, laboratory, pharmacy, HMIS, disease surveillance, electronic medical record and health-worker HR information, with gradual expansion to other states planned.

systems.owner: Ministry of Health; Ministry of Digital Transformation and Communications

systems.system: electronic medical records management system (hospital digitisation, pilot at Soba University Hospital and Gedaref Hospital)
systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Transformation and Communications with Ministry of Health

note: The hospital directive describes an electronic medical-records system and information flow inside health institutions, not data passing between health systems.
DHIS2 is described as one reporting platform whose expansion to link health facilities is a recommendation; no exchange between health systems is stated.
Passages state an integrated HMIS (2013) on DHIS2 (since 2016) to reduce parallel reporting; a single platform, with no exchange between health systems stated.
